calls.title: Scott & Ryan
calls.summary: The team focused on enhancing customer dinner events to increase regional awareness and identify qualified opportunities, with discussions around recent events yielding 20–28 attendees, mostly for brand awareness. Plans were made for curating targeted invite lists in the Southeast to engage major enterprises like Home Depot and UPS. Emphasis was placed on maintaining high pipeline quality, prioritizing serious prospects, and ensuring consistent follow-ups, while significant efforts were also made to engage key accounts such as Change.org and Extra Space Storage to ensure their ongoing commitment and product adoption. Additionally, sales efforts were concentrated on high-probability deals, with operational plans to enhance pipeline hygiene and manage executive relationships.
calls.keywords: customer dinner, funnel metrics, pipeline management, Southeast region, fintech prospects, Change.org integration
